answer: Lock, prove, forfeit: the loop prices identity. Every joiner locks 40 POA into a relic, a soulbound token bound to one key and one trellis slot; duplicate keys are rejected. Every epoch, random users fire sparrow probes at 5% of holders for a fresh signature in 30 seconds; two trellis neighbors co-verify. Fail: the relic melts — 40 POA burned, identity frozen two epochs. One key backs one node, so fakes mint separately. Limits: prices identities, not whales; VMs farm latency. N fakes × 40 POA = 40N POA forfeited.
